coverage_exempt.reason: Original 0x4db6e0 realloc-failure path stores null in EBP at 0x4db70b or 0x4db77f then calls 0x4dc680, which reads [EBP+4] and faults at address4 before returning; case-author original failure probe confirmed EmulationFault at 0x4dc680. Thus the caller null-return fallback cannot execute.

Original 0x4db6e0 successful growth stores requested index as inclusive low at 0x4db757 or inclusive high at 0x4db7dc. Between first bounds check/growth and second check there are only table loads, scratch-zero store, and comparisons, with no external calls or bound writes. Failed growth faults in 0x4dc680 before return. Therefore second out-of-range growth cannot execute.

This is the fallback from the second growth call, which cannot be reached: first successful original 0x4db6e0 includes index in inclusive bounds and no intervening operation modifies bounds; failure faults at [EBP+4] in 0x4dc680. The original second range checks must therefore stay in range.
